messages.subject: rglwidget Problem
parts:
I'm trying to produce RGL plot using Shiny and I am having no luck. Can anybody tell me what is wrong here?

library(shiny)
library(rglwidget)
library(rgl)

server <- function(input, output) {
 
   output$plot3d<-renderRglwidget({
     r=50
    lat <- matrix(seq(90, -90, len = 50)*pi/180, 50, 50, byrow = TRUE)
    long <- matrix(seq(-180, 180, len = 50)*pi/180, 50, 50)
    x <- r*cos(lat)*cos(long)
    y <- r*cos(lat)*sin(long)
    z <- r*sin(lat)
    open3d()
persp3d(x, y, z, col = "white",
            specular = "black", axes = FALSE, box = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "", zlab = "", main = "ck Score",
            normal_x = x, normal_y = y, normal_z = z)
    plot3d(2*x, sin(y), cos(z), plot.type = "confplot", sphere = TRUE, col = "green", radiussphere.rgl = TRUE, add=TRUE)
    #legend3d("bottomright", legend = paste('', colnames(pgr_sphere_cut)), pch = 6, col = clus_color, cex=1)
  })
}
 
ui <- fluidPage(
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      sliderInput("obs", "Number of observations:", min = 10, max = 500, value = 100)
    ),
    mainPanel(rglwidgetOutput("plot3d"))
  )
)

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)


Any help will be greatly appreciated.
